text: Functions shall locate their first instruction in code; globals shall identify distinct nonoverlapping allocations in data/rodata with exact bound type layout. Aux code/pool/metadata definitions may overlap an enclosing function extent. All section bounds/alignment shall be checked; relocated constant bytes shall encode their recorded logical initializer.
